introduction.text: Unofficial read-only Cloud connection. No drinks or machine settings can be changed.

lanNote.text: EXPERIMENTAL: Passive local receiver only. No device registration or commands until active mode is explicitly enabled.

lanListenAddress.label: LAN bind IP (use 127.0.0.1 for local-only test)

lanMachineIp.label: Expected machine LAN IP (required for callback logging)

lanActiveWarning.text: ACHTUNG: Active LAN mode sends POST /local_reg.json?dsn=... with notify:0. This can affect the official Coffee Link app local connection. HTTP 202 means registration accepted, not necessarily encrypted or live counters.

lanActiveEnabled.label: EXPERIMENTAL: Register this adapter as LAN client (may affect Coffee Link app)
